notes.title: Ashfield Hollow is a Featured Title in the No Time to Loot Festival!
notes.content: [p]I'm excited for Ashfield Hollow to be selected as one of few featured titles in the No Time to Loot Steam Festival. The event showcases games built around loot-driven progression and is hosted by Human Qube, in collaboration with Sidekick Publishing (the publishing arm of INSTINCT3).[/p][p]If you’re new to Ashfield Hollow, the demo is available and gives a good sense of the game’s core loop: exploration, risk, and progression across multiple runs.[/p][p]The festival is a great chance to discover other games with similar design goals, so I recommend checking out the full lineup![/p][p]My sincere hanks to everyone who has already played, streamed, or shared feedback so far. [/p][p]Onward and upwards![/p]

notes.title: Ashfield Hollow Demo Out Now!
notes.content: [p]The wait is finally over![/p][p]After months of work, I’m thrilled to announce that the [b]demo for Ashfield Hollow is now live.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Ashfield Hollow[/b] is a 2D post-apocalyptic life sim where you’ll:[/p][list][*][p]Fight zombies in real-time combat[/p][/*][*][p]Scavenge supplies and craft survival gear[/p][/*][*][p]Farm and manage scarce resources[/p][/*][*][p]Meet survivors, build relationships, and grow your community[/p][/*][/list][p]The demo lets you explore the early days of [b]Camp Ashfield[/b] and its surrounding forest and city, just a small slice of the survival and life-sim systems that will continue to expand in the full release.[/p][p]I’d love to hear your thoughts: what’s fun, what needs tuning, and what you’d like to see more of. Your feedback is a huge part of shaping this project.[/p][p][/p][p]👉 [b]Try the demo and wishlist Ashfield Hollow on Steam here:[/b] [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3815560/Ashfield_Hollow/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: A First Look at Ashfield Hollow: New Trailer and Demo Launch
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]After months of development, I’m excited to share that the demo of Ashfield Hollow will launch on September 15th![/p][p]Ashfield Hollow is a 2D post-apocalyptic life sim where you can:[/p][list][*][p]Fight zombies in real-time combat[/p][/*][*][p]Scavenge supplies and craft gear[/p][/*][*][p]Farm and manage resources[/p][/*][*][p]Meet survivors and form relationships[/p][/*][/list][p]The demo covers the early stages of Camp Ashfield and the surrounding forest and city, giving a taste of the survival and life-sim systems that will expand in the full game.[/p][p]I’d love your feedback: what works, what feels fun, and what could be improved. Your thoughts will help shape the game as we move toward full release.[/p][p]You can wishlist the game on Steam here: [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3815560/Ashfield_Hollow/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Thank you for checking it out![/p]
